sloka: अदूराच्चित्रकूटस्य ददर्श भरतस्तदा ।आश्रमं यत्र स मुनिर्भरद्वाज: कृतालय: ॥ २.११३.५॥
transliteration: adūrāccitrakūṭasya dadarśa bharatastadā ।āśramaṁ yatra sa munirbharadvāja: kṛtālaya: ॥ 2.113.5॥

translations.english: Not far from Chitrakuta mountain, Bharata beheld a hermitage where sage Bharadwaja resided.
